_README: Propuestas en inglés de los textos editoriales de los carruseles (fase 2, 2026-10-11). NINGUNA está aprobada todavía: el código no las usa hasta que Santiago las marque VA en Cierres_EN_para_revisar.xlsx y se importen con `python -m tools.traducciones --importar`. Criterio: inglés de EE.UU. para operadores de clínicas y DSOs, frases cortas, sin em dash, sin competir en precisión diagnóstica.

medicaid-adultos.hook: Covered is not the same as paid
medicaid-adultos.data_title: Where the benefit exists, visits follow

medicaid-participacion.hook: Accepting Medicaid costs time, not chairs
medicaid-participacion.data_title: The network has not grown in years
medicaid-participacion.close: More practices won't fix the network.

sin-seguro.hook: Patients who pay out of pocket ask more
sin-seguro.data_title: More people lack dental than medical
sin-seguro.close: Without coverage, every plan gets negotiated.

costo-barrera.hook: The first barrier is not clinical
costo-barrera.data_title: What holds patients back is not the diagnosis
costo-barrera.close: Patients don't object to the price. They postpone.
costo-barrera.close_accent: What isn't understood doesn't get paid for.

utilizacion.hook: Software only measures who already comes
utilizacion.close: The patient who doesn't return already sat in your chair.
utilizacion.close_accent: Winning them back costs less than finding a new one.

ninos-chip.close: The coverage is there. The visit isn't.

adultos-mayores.close: Accumulated need arrives as long plans.
adultos-mayores.close_accent: Long plans are the ones most often abandoned.

urgencias.hook: To the hospital for a tooth
urgencias.close_accent: Almost always for something already seen.

economia-practica.close: A full schedule is not a full register.

gasto-nacional.close: The sector doesn't grow by treating faster.
gasto-nacional.close_accent: It grows by finishing what it already diagnosed.

consolidacion-dso.hook: Fewer practices decide on their own
consolidacion-dso.data_title: Where the decision is made today
consolidacion-dso.close: The decision-maker is no longer in the chair.
consolidacion-dso.close_accent: Selling to a group is a different business.

higienistas.data_title: The staff that doesn't show up
higienistas.close: There is no one to hire.
higienistas.close_accent: All that's left is giving hours back.

demografia-dentista.hook: There isn't a dentist shortage everywhere
demografia-dentista.data_title: How many there are and where
demografia-dentista.close_accent: Recovering an hour of schedule doesn't.

tecnologia-clinica.close_accent: It's justified by time, not diagnosis.

imagen-radiologia.hook: Reading a film is not an exact act
imagen-radiologia.close: Disagreement between readers is already documented.
imagen-radiologia.close_accent: What isn't recorded is what happened next.

cbct-3d.hook: Nobody bought a CBCT for this
cbct-3d.close: More data is not more clarity.

cdt-sin-codigo-ia.hook: An expense, not a revenue line
cdt-sin-codigo-ia.close: No code pays for using AI.
cdt-sin-codigo-ia.close_accent: What gets paid is treatment that gets finished.

codigos-documentan.data_title: Codes that organize what was already done
codigos-documentan.close: A code doesn't create the procedure.

ia-odontologia.data_title: What the profession says, what the market says
ia-odontologia.close: The profession's caution is not resistance.
ia-odontologia.close_accent: It's asking for evidence before changing a workflow.

prevencion.hook: The cleaning that never gets booked
prevencion.close: Preventive care is covered and not completed.
prevencion.close_accent: The problem is getting the patient back.

salud-sistemica.hook: What the gums say about the rest
salud-sistemica.data_title: The mouth in the bigger picture
salud-sistemica.close: Patients understand their mouth when they see it.
salud-sistemica.close_accent: Not when it's named to them.

periodontal.hook: Nobody comes in for their gums
periodontal.close: Much gets diagnosed, little gets finished.
periodontal.close_accent: The accepted plan no one completes.

que-es-dentread.close: Reading the radiograph is the beginning.

ia-radiografias-dentales.data_title: What the system does with the image
ia-radiografias-dentales.close: The image already holds the information.
ia-radiografias-dentales.close_accent: It needs to arrive in time.

apoyo-analisis-radiografico.close: A second look replaces no one.

consistencia-evaluacion.close_accent: They're sustained by a record someone reviews.

comunicacion-visual-paciente.close: Patients don't see what you see.

comprension-y-confianza.close: No one accepts what they don't understand.

aceptacion-tratamientos.close: An accepted plan is not a finished plan.
aceptacion-tratamientos.close_accent: The patient gets lost in between.

seguimiento-continuidad.close: A finding without follow-up gets filed away.

eficiencia-flujo-clinico.data_title: The hours that never get billed

innovacion-radiologia-oral.close: The equipment was upgraded. The process around it wasn't.
innovacion-radiologia-oral.close_accent: That's the margin no one claims.

tecnologia-organizaciones.close: A practice and a group don't buy the same way.
tecnologia-organizaciones.close_accent: They don't measure the same way either.

educacion-dental.close_accent: It's practiced as little as it's taught.

salud-publica-oral.data_title: The mouth left out of the budget
salud-publica-oral.close: What isn't measured never makes it into a budget.
salud-publica-oral.close_accent: Start with what already happens on your schedule.

evolucion-ecosistema.close: Ask any software for a number from last week.
evolucion-ecosistema.close_accent: That's where the demo and the system part ways.

datos: One industry figure doesn't change a schedule.
It changes what to ask at Monday's meeting.
The national average is not your average.
The number describes. It doesn't decide.
The decision still belongs to the clinician.
ai: The workflow around it takes much longer.
The debate is no longer whether AI works.
It's what gets recorded when it's used.
Automating a read is the easy part.
The hard part is someone acting on it.
workflow: Nobody changes a workflow for a demo.
They change it for their own numbers.
clinica: A clinical finding is the start of the path.
The end is a finished treatment.
The workflow that applies it, slower still.

ensayo aleatorizado: A trial answers a narrow question.
It tells you what to watch, not what to buy.
revisión sistemática: A review organizes what was already known.
metaanálisis: It doesn't turn a weak signal into certainty.
estudio multicéntrico: It's the closest thing to real practice.
estudio observacional: It's enough to decide what to measure next.
estudio comparativo: Comparing two paths clarifies your own.
Even if neither one is yours.
_fallback: The clinical decision still belongs to the clinician.
